comment: A Tourist accepts the startup tutorial with MSGTYPE=stop on "Entering the tutorial.". allmain.c maybe_do_tutorial() asks options.c ask_do_tutorial() and passes "Entering the tutorial." to do.c schedule_goto() as the pre-message that deferred_goto() prints; pline.c vpline() looks the line up with msgtype_type() and, for MSGTYP_STOP, calls display_nhwindow(WIN_MESSAGE, TRUE) after putmesg(), so the --More-- comes before goto_level() and the old level and status ($ gold, Dlvl:1) stay under it. The hero then walks onto the second engraving.
